title: Account
loginHint: Log in to use your profiles on any device
imported: Moved {{n}} profile(s) from this browser to your account
guestNote: Every feature works without an account; your player profiles are then stored in this browser only. With an account they follow you to any device, and on first login we move this browser's profiles into it.
privacyNote: We only ask for a username and password. Passwords and recovery codes are stored as hashes only; no game account, email or other data.
memberNote: Your player profiles (you, friends, preferred heroes) are saved to your account and are the same on every device.
deleteConfirm: Your account and saved profiles will be deleted permanently. Enter your password to confirm.
deleted: Your account has been deleted. Thanks for using PickGak!
recoveryExplain: This code lets you reset your password if you forget it. We don't collect email, so there is no other way back in. It is shown only now; keep it in a password manager or a safe note.
copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Please write it down.
recoveryCodeHint: The code you got at sign-up (case and dashes don't matter)
passwordChangeNote: At least 8 characters. Other devices will be logged out.
passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were logged out.
newRecoveryCodeNote: Your previous code will stop working. Enter your password to confirm.
logoutAllNote: Logs out every device, including this one.
